CONSENT FORM

Principal Investigators: Dr Eloi Puig-Mayenco, King's College London, & Dr Adel Chaouch-Orozco, the City University of Hong Kong.

I have been informed about the purpose and procedures of this study, and I understand that I am being invited to participate as a subject in it.

I understand that my participation in this research project is voluntary, and I may withdraw from the research project at any time without penalty of any kind.

I understand that there are no known risks, discomforts or inconveniences associated with my participation in this research project.

I understand that my time commitment to the study will depend on my performance. On average, the study lasts 40 minutes.

I understand that my participation in this research project will be kept confidential and anonymous. My data will be kept confidential and securely stored, with only my anonymous ID identifying it. All personal information will be destroyed after a period of five years from the completion of the project has elapsed.

I understand that I have the right to request access to and correction of the personal data supplied for the project. I also have the right to request further and ongoing information from Dr Eloi Puig-Mayenco (e.puig-mayenco@kcl.ac.uk) & Dr Adel Chaouch-Orozco (adel.chaouchorozco@cityu.edu.hk).

pages.label: I have read this consent form and understand its contents. I freely and voluntarily give my consent to participate in the research project mentioned above.
